visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A black plastic spoon lifts a generous scoop of a two-toned taro dessert from a transparent container. The top layer is a smooth, light beige cream, while the bottom is a thick, pale purple taro paste. The background features lush, out-of-focus green fern leaves in natural lighting. (2) The scene shifts to a retail interior where a female staff member in a black professional suit is seen from the back, stocking shelves. The glass refrigerated display case is filled with rows of square plastic dessert boxes and clear bottles containing white and purple milk tea products with black caps. (3) A close-up shot shows a square dessert box being opened. Inside, layers of white whipped cream and sponge cake are topped with chunks of taro paste and a dusting of crushed yellow pistachios. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the creamy texture of the food. (4) Hands are shown opening a container of deep purple sticky rice. A metal fork slices through the dense, glossy rice to reveal a center of smooth taro paste. The camera focuses on the tactile pull of the sticky rice and the soft taro interior. (5) In a shopping mall setting, a hand holds a square plastic bottle labeled 'share_more^2' filled with a layered taro sago drink. In the background, people in casual clothing walk past colorful mall facades. The video ends with a montage of various taro products and a full-screen text overlay showing event details.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video starts with a close-up against green potted ferns. It transitions to a professional refrigerated retail display shelf and eventually shows a wider view of a busy shopping mall interior with escalators and other shops visible in the distance.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a high-energy, friendly male voice speaking Mandarin at a brisk, enthusiastic pace. He is accompanied by a continuous, upbeat electronic pop BGM with a clear 4/4 drum beat and bright synthesizer pads. The acoustics are clean and studio-like. (2) As the narrator describes the purple rice, a faint 'crinkle' sound from plastic packaging is audible in the background, lasting less than a second. The vocal pitch remains high and engaging, with no signs of strain or roughness. (3) A similar subtle 'plastic rustle' occurs when the mochi dessert is mentioned. The music maintains its steady tempo and major-mode tonality, driving the positive energy of the food review. The narrator's speech density is high, leaving little silence. (4) Toward the end, the acoustic environment shifts slightly to include a very low-level background murmur characteristic of a public shopping mall, though the narration remains the primary signal. The track concludes with a brief fade-out of both the speech and the music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Specific Product Features -> Time-Limited Offer Info -> Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a limited-time taro-themed dessert pop-up shop called 'share_more^2' at the Dream Mall in Kaohsiung. It uses appetizing close-up visuals and high-energy narration to entice food lovers to visit before the event ends.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The narrator explicitly names the shop and location, shows the menu with prices, and displays the brand logo 'share_more^2' throughout the video.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video employs a typical social media food-vlog style with high saturation and fast cuts to maintain viewer engagement. The combination of tactile 'food porn' visuals and clear call-to-action text makes it a highly effective promotional tool.
